entities.summary: Thitu Island, also known as Pag-asa Island ; Đảo Thị Tứ ; Zhongye Island is the second largest of the naturally occurring islands in Spratly Islands, having an area of 37.2 hectares. It lies about 500 kilometers (310 mi) west of Puerto Princesa. Its neighbors are the North Danger Reef to the north, Subi Reef to the southwest, and the Loaita and Tizard Banks to the south. As the poblacion of the Kalayaan municipality of Palawan province in the Philippines, it also administers nearly a dozen other islets, cays and reefs in the Spratly Islands.
